tool_args.rationale: The source response is concave, while the open-branch measurements show substantial sink inhibition. A fitted additive logarithmic bridge captures both effects and can be tested on fresh target-horizon observations. The fixed-horizon data do not identify behavior at other horizons.

considered_alternatives.option: Newton cooling or quartic radiative loss
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither explains the observed strong sink-gradient dependence and saturating source response.
Already acquired; its rows all have the target horizon and add source and gradient coverage, not time variation.
All observations share the same horizon and initial state, so its transient parameters are not identifiable from these rows.
